title: Reproducible Versioned Build Artifacts
objective: Create a reproducible, versioned build-artifact pipeline that records compiler settings and normalized runtime-bytecode hashes for declared artifacts, enabling later source-identity comparison without asserting a match until comparison evidence supports it.
included_scope: Versioned artifact manifest with compiler metadata and hashes
Machine-readable artifact provenance and integrity checks
excluded_scope: Token, liquidity, minting, or asset actions
success_criteria: Every versioned artifact record includes a source path, compiler version, optimizer settings, normalized runtime-bytecode hash, and reproducible build command.
CI rebuilds or validates the artifact manifest deterministically.
Artifact records distinguish present artifacts from missing or unreproducible ones.
No Phase 9 source-identity state is upgraded without a separate verified comparison.
The static build and verification checks pass.
